report.model_summary: Revenue rose from $189,316.83 to $318,362.28 (+$129,045.45). Most is real: correct November paid revenue on current data is $304,396.67 (up $115,079.84), including $106,760.98 from 1,077 orders after Nov 24. The rest is a join bug: the new INNER JOIN to customers adds $25,520.52 of duplicates while dropping $11,555.91 of 131 unmatched orders, for a net overstatement of $13,965.61.

evidence.sql: SELECT order_id, revenue_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND order_date < '2026-12-01' AND kind <> 'refund'
SELECT order_id, revenue_cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND order_date < '2026-12-01' AND kind <> 'refund'

SELECT o.order_id, o.revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-11-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-12-01'
  AND o.kind <> 'refund'

SELECT o.order_id, o.revenue_cents
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'paid'
  AND o.order_date >= '2026-11-01'
  AND o.order_date < '2026-12-01'
  AND o.kind <> 'refund'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cust_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_ids, COUNT(*) - COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS extra_rows FROM customers
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dup_customer_ids, SUM(cnt - 1) AS extra_rows FROM (SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM customers GROUP BY customer_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS unmatched_orders, SUM(o.revenue_cents) AS unmatched_cents FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-12-01' AND o.kind <> 'refund' AND c.customer_id IS NULL

SELECT COUNT(*) AS join_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS distinct_orders, SUM(o.revenue_cents) AS join_sum FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-12-01' AND o.kind <> 'refund'

SELECT o.order_id, o.revenue_cents, COUNT(*) AS dup_n FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-12-01' AND o.kind <> 'refund' GROUP BY o.order_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT SUM((cnt - 1) * revenue_cents) AS dup_excess_cents, SUM(CASE WHEN c_null = 1 THEN revenue_cents ELSE 0 END) AS unmatched_cents FROM (SELECT o.order_id, o.revenue_cents, COUNT(c.customer_id) AS cnt, CASE WHEN COUNT(c.customer_id) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS c_null FROM orders o LEFT JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'paid' AND o.order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND o.order_date < '2026-12-01' AND o.kind <> 'refund' GROUP BY o.order_id, o.revenue_cents)

SELECT CASE WHEN order_date <= '2026-11-24' THEN 'through_Nov24' ELSE 'after_Nov24' END AS period, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(revenue_cents) AS cents FROM orders WHERE status = 'paid' AND order_date >= '2026-11-01' AND order_date < '2026-12-01' AND kind <> 'refund' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
